evidence_items.claim: ING is NOT a FINOS member - not listed on FINOS members page
evidence_items.excerpt: ING, ING Bank, and ING Group are not listed among FINOS members across any membership tier.

evidence_items.claim: ING is a member of ISDA and has adhered to ISDA protocols (IBOR 2020, Resolution Stay)
evidence_items.excerpt: ING Bank N.V. and several subsidiaries have registered adherence to the IBOR (2020) Protocol in line with the recommendations of various industry bodies and working groups.

evidence_items.claim: ING Capital Markets LLC is CFTC registered swap dealer, subject to Dodd-Frank regulation
evidence_items.excerpt: ING Capital Markets LLC is registered with the CFTC as a swap dealer and is subject to CFTC regulation.

evidence_items.claim: ING executed world's first Sustainability-Linked Derivative (2019) - innovation in derivatives
evidence_items.excerpt: In August 2019, ING executed the world's first Sustainability-Linked Derivative by using KPIs to determine certain sustainable goals.

evidence_items.claim: ING has open source presence on GitHub with 56 repositories including Open Banking SDK
evidence_items.excerpt: ING Bank maintains 56 repositories on GitHub including Open Banking SDK.

null_results.actual_result: ING is NOT a FINOS member. No CDM contribution found.
No ING representative on current ISDA Board.
